statements.status_notes: GHSA-GCJH-H69Q-9W9G affects github.com/google/cel-go versions 0.22.0 through 0.28.1, fixed in 0.29.0. The keda-metrics-apiserver image depends on k8s.io/apiserver which has transitive dependency constraints that prevent upgrading cel-go to 0.29.0. Attempting to pin cel-go@v0.29.0 causes go mod tidy to downgrade it back to satisfy k8s.io/apiserver compatibility requirements. This is a known incompatibility pattern affecting multiple Kubernetes ecosystem projects. Remediation requires either an upstream keda release with updated k8s.io dependencies that support cel-go 0.29.0+, or a backported security patch to the 0.22.x/0.26.x branches.
